summary: Concord may ship skills that operate structures defined by accepted law and verified by Concord checks, starting with Domain-shape stewardship. Skills reuse the versioned release and central installation route, name only Concord operations and Product-declared tooling, and hold no independent evidence, approval, or law authority. Lane methodology stays host-owned. Skill implementation and conformance remain outstanding.
title: Concord ships the skill that operates its Domain shape
